meta.themes: Frontier AI Specializes, Agent Infrastructure Hardens, AI Business Models Expand, Transparency Pressure Rises

news.title: OpenAI introduced Astra for Law with legal search and governance controls
news.summary: OpenAI launched Astra for Law, combining GPT-6 Astra with a legal search index, professional workflow instructions, confidential-work controls, and 26 partner-built plugins for law firms and legal technology companies.

news.title: AWS rebuilt AgentCore runtime for elastic, long-running agent workloads
news.summary: AWS released a new AgentCore runtime that reclaims unused session memory and restores pre-initialized snapshots to keep cold starts consistent across container sizes and concurrency levels.

news.title: AWS launched GPU-aware routing for SageMaker HyperPod inference
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference Gateway uses live GPU, queue, cache, and adapter signals to route OpenAI-compatible requests across EKS model pods, cutting first-token latency by up to 82% in AWS tests.

news.title: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live models for production voice agents
news.summary: Google released Gemini 3.8 Live and an Extended Thinking variant with near-real-time multimodal dialogue, parallel reasoning, background tool use, and access through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

news.title: Anthropic moved Claude into collaborative document and presentation work
news.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Docs alongside presentation and design capabilities, letting users draft, revise, collaborate on, and export business documents without leaving Claude.

news.title: OpenAI added sponsored agents and AI campaign tools to ChatGPT Ads
news.summary: OpenAI began testing clearly labeled sponsored-agent conversations and added prompt-driven campaign management, AI creative assistance, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify to its advertising platform.

news.title: Meta bundled expanded AI usage into a global subscription service
news.summary: Meta launched Meta One plans for individuals, creators, and businesses, pairing higher usage of compute-intensive AI features with creator tools, business-agent access, and subscription tiers starting at $2.99 per month.

news.title: AI safety warnings triggered a global selloff in AI-linked stocks
news.summary: AI-related shares fell across global markets after leading laboratory executives called for slower frontier development, adding risk concerns to investor scrutiny of debt-funded infrastructure spending.

news.title: Anthropic proposed public metrics for tracking frontier AI development
news.summary: Anthropic proposed recurring measurements of AI-led research, agent oversight, and compute allocation, reporting that Claude now leads 26% of its measured AI research and development work while none is fully autonomous.

news.title: GitHub expanded Copilot reviews, model controls, and agent operations
news.summary: GitHub's weekly Copilot release added multi-agent Lite reviews, shell-assisted validation, configurable auto-model tiers, Sentry-to-fix workflows, enterprise agent metrics, and local Dev Container support.

news.title: Cloudflare added inspectable logs, network traces, and DOM state to browser-agent runs
news.summary: Cloudflare Browser Run session recordings gained an Inspect panel for console logs, network requests, timing waterfalls, HAR export, and reconstructed DOM state to help teams debug automated browser workflows.

news.title: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 posted its first MLPerf inference results
news.summary: NVIDIA reported that preview Vera Rubin NVL72 submissions delivered up to 3.7 times the Qwen3-VL throughput and up to 2.5 times the DeepSeek-R1 throughput of GB300 NVL72 systems in MLPerf Inference v6.1.
